name: Third Coast Mahjong
description: Wilmette mahjong community. Its classes teach American-style mahjong and the official National Mah Jongg League card, and players are asked to bring their own NMJL card to open play (a few loaner cards on hand). Mahj 101, 102 and 103 are small classes in its Ginkgo Room, with guided open play and open play for every level; snacks and drinks are provided.
schedule: Open play, guided open play and Mahj 101-103 classes through the week (dates listed on the club site)
